verdict.rationale: Microsoft Teams is documented as programmable via Microsoft Graph API (creating teams/channels, posting chat messages, automating conversations) plus webhooks/connectors and an Agents Toolkit CLI for building and deploying agents/apps, giving AI-native users multiple documented public API surfaces to drive the product externally (ms-teams-docs-8, ms-teams-docs-11, ms-teams-docs-19, ms-teams-docs-34, ms-teams-docs-16/22/23/24). Missing for 10: a discoverable machine-readable OpenAPI/llms.txt spec (probes show 404s) and independent/hands-on developer corroboration beyond first-party docs.
